name: dotnet LawnDart eShop Ordering
description: Ordering bounded context for a LawnDart-style rewrite of Microsoft eShop Ordering. Place Order emits evt-order-started (Basket) and later evt-order-awaiting-validation / evt-order-paid (Catalog). Stock confirm/reject consume Catalog events; payment success is a forward-ref into Mark Order Paid. Payment capture itself stays in Payment workspace. Grace period: the OrderProcessor worker publishes Grace Period Confirmed and the Confirm Grace Period automation issues Mark Order Awaiting Validation.

widgets.name: Grace Period Confirmed (from OrderProcessor)
widgets.description: Published by the OrderProcessor worker when a submitted order's grace period has elapsed (token grace-period-confirmed; message id is a version 5 id derived from the order id). OrderProcessor's TrackSubmittedOrderReactor records each Order Started; GracePeriodManagerService checks every CheckUpdateTime (default 30 s) and publishes once GracePeriodTime (default 1 minute) has passed. OrderProcessor has no workspace of its own, so the event is held here. eShop name: GracePeriodConfirmedIntegrationEvent.

swimlanes.name: Place Order
swimlanes.description: Checkout: shopper submits basket as an order (Submitted). Emits Order Placed and Order Started (basket-clear signal for Basket automation). Cross-workspace dependencies: Basket Contents (Basket workspace), Shopper Account Profile (Identity workspace). Order lines use the basket's add-time price snapshot. The order keeps a masked card snapshot (card type, holder, expiry, last four digits); the Identity profile has no card fields.

swimlanes.name: Order Summary
swimlanes.description: Shopper read model for a single order detail as status progresses.

swimlanes.name: Confirm Grace Period
swimlanes.description: When the grace period after Order Started elapses, Ordering issues Mark Order Awaiting Validation. Built with an explicit Grace Period Confirmed signal. The OrderProcessor worker records Order Started (TrackSubmittedOrderReactor), checks every CheckUpdateTime (default 30 s), and publishes Grace Period Confirmed once GracePeriodTime (default 1 minute) has passed (GracePeriodManagerService). This automation (ConfirmGracePeriodReactor in Ordering API) subscribes to Grace Period Confirmed and issues Mark Order Awaiting Validation. Grace Period Confirmed is held on the Inbound Catalog/Payment Signals (mirrors) slice because OrderProcessor has no workspace.

swimlanes.name: Mark Order Awaiting Validation
swimlanes.description: Moves Submitted → AwaitingValidation after the grace period. Emits evt-order-awaiting-validation for Catalog stock check. Owned by Ordering API; issued by the Confirm Grace Period automation when the OrderProcessor worker publishes Grace Period Confirmed. Only a Submitted order moves; any other status, including a repeat confirmation, writes no event.

swimlanes.name: Inbound Catalog/Payment Signals (mirrors)
swimlanes.description: Import-only holder for Catalog/Payment event mirrors so Ordering automations resolve subscribedEventIds without listing them on Mark Stock Confirmed / Cancel For Stock / Mark Paid Events zones. Modeling scaffolding only, no code; real delivery is the producing context's integration event over the bus. Also holds Grace Period Confirmed, published by the OrderProcessor worker (no workspace of its own), so Confirm Grace Period can subscribe to it.

swimlanes.name: When Catalog Stock Confirmed
swimlanes.description: Catalog evt-order-stock-confirmed → Mark Order Stock Confirmed.

swimlanes.name: Mark Order Stock Confirmed
swimlanes.description: AwaitingValidation → StockConfirmed after Catalog Order Stock Confirmed. Emits status event for Payment to charge.

swimlanes.name: When Catalog Stock Rejected
swimlanes.description: Catalog evt-order-stock-rejected → Cancel Order For Insufficient Stock.

swimlanes.name: Cancel Order For Insufficient Stock
swimlanes.description: AwaitingValidation → Cancelled when Catalog rejects stock (SetCancelledStatusWhenStockIsRejected).

swimlanes.name: When Payment Succeeded
swimlanes.description: Payment evt-payment-succeeded → Mark Order Paid (forward-ref until Payment workspace exists).

swimlanes.name: Mark Order Paid
swimlanes.description: StockConfirmed → Paid after payment succeeds. Emits evt-order-paid for Catalog stock deduction.

swimlanes.name: When Payment Failed
swimlanes.description: Payment evt-payment-failed → Cancel Order (shopper/operator cancel command).

swimlanes.name: Cancel Order
